# Setup Specification — Dual Momentum Swing Executor

## Screener
- Name: Dual Momentum Swing (id `23f1962b`)
- Interval: Daily; use completed signal candles and the screener's own universe.
- Runtime parameters: side=both, strength_filter=all, max_risk_pct=2, limit=10
## Alerts and scope
- Process only new signals and alert every taken or skipped signal with its reason.
- When flat, select only the highest-ADX BUY/SELL signal for the day.
- Direction comes exclusively from the screener's `direction` column; NEUTRAL or missing direction is not tradable.
## Trade legs
- Enter by market on the next session open.
- Use signal `stop_price` and `target_price` when valid; otherwise use 2.5% from entry.
- Allow one open position across the setup; skip (do not queue) all new signals while occupied.
- Exit at close after 5 sessions if unrealized PnL is <= 0; always exit after 10 sessions.
- Use runtime `setup.sizing.per_position_cap` for capital sizing and runtime holding-period settings for maximum holding.
- Custom instructions (verbatim): Stop-loss and target MUST come from the signal row's stop_price / target_price columns when valid (fallback 2.5% only when missing). One open position at a time; when a position is open skip new signals entirely and alert the skip. When flat, pick only the highest-adx signal of the day. Exit at session close if 5 sessions elapse with unrealized PnL <= 0 (stall exit), and always close after 10 sessions.
## Guardrails
- Maximum one new trade per day; maximum one open position.
- Pause entries for the day if realized daily loss exceeds Rs 60,000.
- Default per-position cap: Rs 2,000,000; product: CNC for overnight carry.

## Baseline (fixed for every setup)
- The engine evaluates at every completed screener candle close; the module adds no schedule or data wait.
- The engine's runtime sizing and holding-period configuration are respected.
